subject: An office that closes away
hook: Making doors close neatly over a desk
ig:
Making cupboard doors close neatly over a working desk comes down to three workshop steps.

The cut. The desktop is cut to sit between the cupboard sides, with depth chosen around the screen and keyboard you actually use.

The edge. The front edge gets ABS edging. It is the edge your wrists rest on all day, so it needs to be sealed and smooth.

The holes. Hinge cups are drilled on our boring machine, so the holes line up on every door. That is what lets a pair of doors meet with an even gap when the office is shut.

Then it is assembled and checked in our Hanley workshop, and fitted by our own team.

Planning a closing office this autumn? DM us 'OFFICE' and we will send the details.
fb:
A quick look at how we make a home office that shuts away at the end of the day.

The desktop is cut in our workshop to fit between the cupboard sides, the front edge is sealed with ABS so it's smooth under your wrists, and the hinge holes are drilled on our boring machine so the doors line up properly. It's all assembled in Hanley before it comes to you.
